units.source_text: “真的哟……所以，一到夜里，那凸角就会一点点大起来呢……

en.t: “It really is true... so, once night comes, that protruding corner starts getting bigger little by little...

units.source_text: 风向不好的日子里呀，真的呢，有这么大一块，像蘑菇的伞似的垂下来……

en.t: On days when the wind is bad, honestly, a piece this big hangs down like the cap of a mushroom...

units.source_text: 一到下午，干燥了，嘭地全掉下来了……

en.t: By afternoon, once it dries out, it all comes crashing down with a thud...

units.source_text: 要是掉得不巧，掉在细细的柱子之类上面，

en.t: If it falls badly and lands on something like a slender post,
it will be crushed flat at once...”
